description: Data for: Economies of scale and scope in expansion of the U.S. natural gas pipeline network provides cost, capacity, length and technical observations for US natural-gas pipeline projects. The provider is Oliver, Matthew. Geographical and temporal coverage: The associated study analyses 254 projects from 1997 to 2012; this is a study-specific economic dataset. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-NC-3.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
